How to play

Clear the maze, mind the beetles, trust the wheel.

In the maze

Cheese +50. Every wedge in the maze must be collected before the nest opens. The cheese counter in the HUD tracks your progress.

Beetles. Each one patrols a fixed route through the junctions and open stretches, marching back and forth without ever stopping — so the stretch it guards always opens up again. Watch its rhythm, wait for your gap, then slip through. One touch costs a life and sends you back to the maze entrance — lose all three lives and the run ends. Higher levels have more beetles, moving faster.

The nest. In the far corner of the maze. It stays shut while any cheese remains; once your cheeks are full, reaching it pays a +200 bonus and grows the next maze.

A maze per block. Each layout is generated deterministically from the live block height (builder.anchor.blockHeight) — replay the same block and you get the same maze; a new block grows a new one.

The wheel sets the pace

Squeekchain is a real hamster wheel doing real proof-of-work: a sensor rig measures every spin, an oracle checks it, and the work settles into blocks on Sepolia. This game reads the same public feed.

The beetles' patrol speed scales with the real wheel's live RPM — when Squeektoshi runs hard on the real wheel, the beetles hurry too. The trade-off: while the feed says RUNNING with the wheel turning, every point you earn is doubled.

Feed down? The game doesn't stop: the maze keeps the last block it was seeded from and the beetles fall back to base speed, with the live feed panel saying the feed is stale or offline.

A wallet is optional here — it only powers the daily check-in. No tokens, nothing to buy — just solve the maze. Built for the Squeekchain Genesis builder track.

My Card

Squeek Maze Cards (SQMC) — one free Sepolia NFT per wallet. Your card's Speed, Lives and Luck change how the maze plays, and clearing mazes earns it XP. Contracts are live on Sepolia: SqueekMazeCard ↗ · Market ↗. The game plays exactly the same with no card and no wallet.

XP & Sync Level

Clear a maze with a card connected to earn +50 XP per maze, tracked in this browser per wallet.

Sync Level can only be called by the contract owner or the game backend wallet (the contract's onlyOwnerOrGame rule). If your wallet is not the owner, this transaction will revert — your XP is still tracked locally in the game.
